parts.html: The K-31 kitchen model combines a contemporary L-shaped layout with light lime green upper cabinets and brown wood-effect lower fronts. This distinctive combination brings color and natural-looking texture into one coordinated furniture composition.

The light lime green upper cabinetry introduces a fresh, gentle accent, while the warm brown wood-look finish of the lower cabinets gives the kitchen a grounded and welcoming character. Rather than using a uniform wood finish throughout, K-31 creates visual contrast between its upper and lower sections.

The two finishes can be paired with light walls, neutral grey or beige materials, ceramic tiles, and stone-effect surfaces. The result is suitable for a contemporary apartment, private residence, or open-plan kitchen-living area.

K-31 has an L-shaped configuration, with cabinetry arranged along two adjoining walls. This layout makes use of the corner and allows work surfaces and storage to be distributed between separate sections.

The kitchen has a total linear length of 3.9 meters, with standard dimensions of 3.9 × 2.3 × 0.6 m. The positions of the sink, hob, refrigerator, and other built-in appliances can be determined during individual planning according to room dimensions and existing service connections. A separate kitchen island is not part of the standard model.

Both upper and lower cabinet fronts are made from laminated particleboard, but feature different finishes. The upper cabinets have a solid light lime green finish, while the lower and remaining fronts have a brown wood-effect decor.

The cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard, and the countertop is chipboard-based. The wood-grain appearance is provided by the decorative finish of the laminated fronts; solid timber is not part of the stated standard specification.

A defining functional feature of K-31 is its FREE FOLD Hafele lift mechanism, included in the standard configuration. It allows the relevant upper cabinet fronts to open upwards, providing convenient access to upper-level storage.
The kitchen also includes a pull-out cargo storage system for organizing food and kitchen essentials.

Hinged cabinet doors use Muller Profi Line hinges with soft-close. Pull-out elements are equipped with Muller telescopic runners without soft-close. Cabinet handles are included in the standard specification.

K-31 can also be customized to suit individual requirements. Upon request, clients can choose more functional furniture fittings, upgraded opening mechanisms, and additional storage systems. Alternative materials are available as well, ranging from budget-friendly solutions to premium finishes. These are optional upgrades and are specified separately from the standard model.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments and private residences in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-31 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, service connections, and built-in appliance requirements. Clients can select alternative shades, cabinet and countertop materials, hardware, and internal storage to suit their preferred functionality and budget.

Our services include kitchen planning, material and hardware selection, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. Sinks, taps, extractor hoods, and household appliances can also be selected upon request.
